title: clematis sibirica var. iliensis
intro: Clematis sibirica var. iliensis, commonly known as Sibirian Clematis, is a flowering plant species within the Ranunculaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Sibirian Clematis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
